headline: Heavy Fighting Escalates on Several Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition the deadliest sectors have deepened their toll while the map elsewhere remains largely unchanged. Weathered Expanse still leads the butcher’s bill, adding roughly 6,600 Colonial and 7,000 Warden dead in the past day with hourly loss rates climbing sharply. Nevish Line has surged to about 7,100 Colonial and 7,500 Warden casualties, both sides now bleeding faster than before. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand continue to record the most ownership turnover — 28 base‑change events each — with Marban’s Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall and Kuura’s Faden Point the busiest sites. Linn Mercy’s tempo has sharpened further, posting over 3,100 Colonial and 4,300 Warden losses in 24 hours alongside accelerating enlistments. Godcrofts produced six flips overnight, including two bases turning neutral, while Stlican Shelf added a handful of changes. Stonecradle, Dead Lands and Callahans Passage remain casualty‑heavy but show no territorial movement. Enlistment spikes persist in the hottest zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
